source: Heavenly 2025-26 trail map (image supplied by the owner, 2026-11-17), symbols read by hand
note: Mott and Killebrew Canyons are a gated experts-only area; every run inside is listed as 3 whether or not it carries its own symbol. Sky Canyon carries a black diamond on the 2024-25 map (an earlier reading split its label into 'Sky' and 'Sky Canyon').

not_runs.Killebrew Canyon: The name of the gated experts-only area; its runs (Outer Limits, Pipeline, Ramarrah's, The Fingers, Stateline Chute, Bob's Boulevard, Sweetwater, Boundary Chutes) are each on the map.
not_runs.Rocky Point: An area name printed inside Mott Canyon between Bill's and Promise Land with no run line of its own; the map runs there (Under the Gun, Pac-Man) are double black.

lifts_source: Heavenly trail map by James Niehues, 2024 printing (skimap.org map 30139), lift labels read by hand; the map counts 28 lifts, the others being unnamed learning-area carpets

lifts_explained.Red Fir: small beginner lift on the resort's map; not in OpenStreetMap (checked 2026-11-22); position unknown: add as extra_lifts when found
lifts_explained.Black Bear Carpet: beginner carpet on the resort's map; not in OpenStreetMap (checked 2026-11-22); position unknown: add as extra_lifts when found
